items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins, I understand, grabbed him.

ctx.x: Muggsy walked up to him and started to tell him what he thought about him. And Feather reached in his pocket and pulled out some manuscripts. "But Muggsy, I came here to write and I love you and all." With that, he hit him, and Leonard ran. And he ran and Muggsy chased him. And ran around the block and saw a restaurant, a Greek restaurant, and ran in there and shut the door.

Well, the Greek -- you're not shutting my door during business hours. So somehow he saved Leonard's rear end and Muggsy let it go at that one punch. But the story is now going around the Village, amongst those guys, that that's what happened. But he wasn't the only one. Coleman Hawkins, I understand, grabbed him. Danny Alvin grabbed him. A bass player that went to jail because of pot, who played for this pianist whose father also played piano years ago.
